description:
## [1.3.0](https://github.com/Piracola/Pixiv-Patched/compare/v1.2.0...v1.3.0) (2026-11-03)

### ✨ New Features

* open the local history in Pixiv's own history screen ([334ce04](https://github.com/Piracola/Pixiv-Patched/commit/334ce04a78c1f03c87ebe9c6407ae4b27a594ecc))

patches.name: Pixiv AI Work Flagger
patches.description: Identifies AI-generated works, dims thumbnails with an [AI] badge (or hides them completely), displays a full-width warning banner below the top toolbar on artwork detail, adds title [AI] pill, auto-blocks AI artists, and provides in-app settings with tag editor.

patches.name: Pixiv Adblocker
patches.description: Eliminates bottom advertising banners and interstitials across all screens without layout padding, suppresses rate-this-app dialogs, and hides sponsored works in feeds.

patches.name: Pixiv Browsing History
patches.description: Records the illustrations, manga and novels opened in the app into an on-device browsing history, and shows it in the app's own history screen (manga and novels apart) instead of Pixiv's server-side list.

patches.name: Pixiv Downloader
patches.description: Adds a button to the illustration and manga detail view to download original full-quality artwork directly to your Photos library with clean metadata filenames.

patches.name: Pixiv Enhanced Viewer & Instant Zoom
patches.description: Displays the standard-resolution artwork as an instant placeholder while the full-resolution image loads, allows immediate pinch-to-zoom/pan preserving zoom coordinates upon high-res load, and shows a discreet loading indicator.

patches.name: Pixiv OLED Dark Theme
patches.description: Overrides dark gray surface and background colors with pure pitch black (#ff000000) for OLED battery savings and true high-contrast dark mode.

patches.name: Pixiv Popular Search Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks sorting search results by popularity (popular_desc) without a premium subscription or trial countdown.

patches.name: Pixiv Premium Features
patches.description: Emulates client-side Pixiv Premium membership status and removes the mute list limits.

patches.name: Pixiv-Patched Drawer Entry
patches.description: Adds a Pixiv-Patched item to Pixiv's home drawer that opens a page with the state of every patch, the AI work settings and the browsing history kept on this device.
